metadata.title: ComputerManagementDsc
metadata.description:
The ComputerManagementDsc module contains DSC resources for configuration of a Windows computer. These DSC resources allow you to perform computer management tasks, such as renaming the computer, joining a domain and scheduling tasks as well as configuring items such as virtual memory, event logs, time zones and power settings.

All of the resources in the DSC Resource Kit are provided AS IS, and are not supported through any Microsoft standard support program or service.

findings.title: Possible hard-coded credential
findings.description: A credential-like variable appears to be assigned a literal value. Review the source; the matched value is redacted.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Register-ScheduledTask' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Set-ScheduledTask' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
